transcript: I went to Lantern Cafe in Pune and really liked it. The mushroom noodles were excellent. It is good for two or three friends, but the tables are too small for a large group. I think the starters were around 180 when I visited last winter. The portions are small, so order a few plates.

Kite Kitchen in Gurugram has the best ramen I have tried in Delhi. Arun fixed my kitchen tap in Jaipur, but it started leaking again after a week. I would not recommend him for that job. My friend Nisha suggested Meena for swimming lessons. I have not tried Meena's classes.
Maine Saffron Cafe Pune mein try kiya. Chai bahut achhi thi, lekin service slow thi. Weekend pe jaldi ho toh mat jaana. Price shayad 80 tha, exact yaad nahi.

Dr. Neha Rao practices in Jaipur. I have visited her for minor illnesses for years. She listens carefully and her practical advice has helped me. I would recommend her as a general doctor. I do not know her exact qualifications or clinic phone number.
